artworks.title: Spread Thy Wings and Away!
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman kneeling on a patterned surface. She extends her right hand towards a bird perched on it. The woman has long hair with floral decorations, delicate facial features, and is elegantly dressed in a detailed outfit. The background features ornate decor, including a vase, plants, and luxurious drapery and pillows. The phrase "SPREAD THY WINGS AND AWAY!" is written above her.

artworks.title: Señor de los Milagros (Lord of Miracles)
artworks.medium: engraving printed in dark green on wove paper with chain lines
artworks.description: The image shows a full view of the crucifixion scene with Christ on the cross in the center. Christ's body hangs on the cross with arms outstretched, and his facial features are drawn in a solemn expression, with long hair falling to the sides. He is clothed in a loincloth. To the left of the cross stands a female figure, likely Mary, portrayed in full body, wearing a long robe adorned with floral patterns, and she has a serene expression with a halo surrounding her head. On the right, another female figure in a similar robe with a veil covers her head, possibly Mary Magdalene, is shown kneeling with a bowed head and contemplative posture. Above the cross, there is a depiction of a bearded male figure within a cloud, possibly representing God, with arms open and a circular radiance around his head. The background is filled with lines and dots representing clouds and sky, with the sun on the left and the moon on the right. In the lower right corner, a structure resembling a church with multiple domes is faintly illustrated against the backdrop of a cloudy sky. Latin text is inscribed at the bottom, further detailing the context.

artworks.title: Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a detailed black and white engraving depicting a scene of chaos in an ancient city. The image features numerous figures in turmoil in the foreground, classical architecture on the right, including a portico with columns, additional structures in the background, a towering column on the left, stylized clouds in the sky, and a decorative text frame at the bottom. The composition conveys movement and panic with intricate details in both figures and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Gezicht van't Koningsplein naar de Reguliers of Munts-Tooren, Te Amsterdam
artworks.artist: Paulus van Liender after Jan de Beyer
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 31.1 x 38.4 cm (12 1/4 x 15 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a historical urban setting. There is a canal with individuals wearing historical attire gathered along the bank. Trees provide shade in the foreground, while buildings obscure the horizon. A clock tower is prominently featured in the distance. The illustration is characterized by detailed linework and cross-hatching techniques for depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic in varying tones of brown and beige, giving it an antique sepia-toned effect. The scene conveys a sense of heritage and history through its depiction of clothing and architecture.

artworks.title: The Daughters of Minyas
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring multiple figures. In the foreground, a figure is leaning towards another group. An animal with leopard-like spots is present. In the background, structures are on fire with smoke rising. An angelic figure is flying above. Figures on a bench appear surprised and scared. The scene is framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Minerva Changing Arachne into a Spider
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman reaching out to a sun and cloud motif while standing in a room. The drawing is detailed with hatching and cross-hatching for shading and texture. The woman in classical attire gestures towards a bright symbol that appears to be a sun surrounded by clouds or a large spider web in the upper portion of the artwork. She stands beside a table that supports additional objects. The room has architectural features like an open window revealing greenery outside. The artwork is enclosed within an ornate border featuring a repetitive leaf pattern.

artworks.title: Amphion
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a stone step or platform. They are leaning back, playing a lute. The person has detailed facial features and curly hair. They wear a long robe. Stone columns and foliage surround them, with buildings in the distance. The image is framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Midas with Apollo and Pan
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with mythological figures. The image portrays a gathering in a lush landscape featuring three figures: two seated and one standing. They are situated under trees, with dotted foliage providing a dense backdrop. The seated figure on the left appears to possess both human and animal features, engaging with another seated figure adorned with cloth draped over their body. The third figure, standing, is dressed in elaborate attire that includes a helmet with wings. Shadows and textures are skillfully rendered through the use of line work, creating depth and a sense of realism within this mythological tableau.

artworks.title: Funeral Pyre of Memnon
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines that create a dynamic composition. There are birds and a figure among the forms. In the background, there is an outline of a distant landscape and architectural structures.

artworks.title: Hippolytus and the Sea Monster
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving with a vast landscape featuring rugged rocks, a body of water, and a horizon. In the center is a multi-headed creature resembling a dragon. Additionally, a chariot wheel and part of a figure are visible near the rocks. The engraving is created using fine lines and hatching for texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, utilizing black and white shades for contrast.

artworks.title: Madame de Maintenon
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (trimmed within plate mark along left edge): 21.5 x 14.7 cm (8 7/16 x 5 13/16 in.)
sheet: 24.5 x 16 cm (9 5/8 x 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: There is a portrait depicting the upper body of a woman in profile, facing to the left. She is upright with her head turned to the side. Her facial features include a straight nose and a slightly curved lip. She has elaborate hair styled back and curled, with additional curls around her neck. She wears a dress with visible lace trim and a pattern resembling checkered or plaid. Adornments include a pearl necklace, drop earrings, and a lace or ruffled collar. The background shows an oval frame in a crosshatch pattern within a rectangular border with the name "M. de Maintenon."

artworks.title: Le Grand-Conde
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a person's upper body, focused on the head and shoulders. The person is positioned in profile, facing to the right. The facial features include a prominent nose and well-defined cheekbones, with long, curly hair cascading down to the shoulders. The person is wearing a draped garment. The background is a dark oval surrounded by decorative elements, with an ornate border framing the entire portrait. Below the image, there is a label with the name "LE GRAND CONDÉ."

artworks.title: Buffon
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Piat Joseph Sauvage
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed portrait of a man's head and shoulders in profile. The man has distinct features with a prominent nose and appears elderly. His hair is styled in a white or light color, tied back with a ribbon, and he wears a high-collared garment typical of the 18th century. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame on a dark textured background, with the name "BUFFON" below the image. Corner text identifies the artist.

artworks.title: Jean Racine
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual from the chest up. The person is facing forward with a slightly angled head in a three-quarter profile. They have distinct facial features including a nose, lips, and eyes. The person has thick, curly hair falling past the shoulders. They wear formal attire with a high-collared shirt and a dark coat. The background features a textured or etched design with an oval frame surrounding the figure and the text "J. Racine" below.

artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste-Louis Gresset
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the head and upper torso of a man within an oval frame. The man's body is angled slightly, facing towards the right while he gazes directly at the viewer. He has well-defined facial features including arched eyebrows and a subtle smile. His hair is styled in soft curls typical of the 18th century. The man is dressed in a formal jacket with a visible shirt and a cravat or necktie. Below the portrait, within a rectangular plaque, the name "J.B.L. GRESSET." is inscribed. The background is plain and textured, with the engraving set against a light-colored paper.

artworks.title: Francois de Malherbe
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man with detailed facial features, curly hair, and a ruffled collar. He is facing the viewer with a slight turn to his right. The background features an oval frame, textured lines, and a plaque inscribed with the name "MALHERBE." The engraving is on textured paper.

artworks.title: Jean de La Fontaine
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man depicted from the shoulders up, positioned in profile facing to the viewer's left. He has long, wavy hair cascading down over his shoulders, and his facial features include a prominent nose and a strong jawline. He is wearing a high-collared garment with a cravat. The portrait is enclosed in a circular frame with a textured background, and below this image is a plaque-like space that reads "J. DE LA FONTAINE." The overall background is a plain, light-colored canvas.

artworks.title: Portrait of Whistler with a Paintbrush
artworks.medium: pen and ink over graphite on white wove paper; laid down on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The person faces the viewer, holding a paintbrush in their right hand and a palette in their left hand. They have curly hair, a beard, and a mustache. The person is wearing a long-sleeved shirt, pants, and a bow tie or ribbon. The background has textured, shaded lines.

artworks.title: The Nativity with God the Father and the Holy Spirit
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 28.2 x 19.9 cm (11 1/8 x 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a figure holding a child surrounded by plants. The scene gives off a spiritual feeling, with clouds or mystical figures present. The intricate cross-hatching and line work bring depth and texture to the image, highlighting the gentle expressions and fabric folds. The atmosphere of the drawing conveys tranquility and protection.

artworks.title: Au ravin de la faille, Auvergne (The Ravine at Auvergne)
artworks.medium: etching on chine applique [proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a forest landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The dense canopy of trees creates a border at the top of the image. The intricate etching technique depicts tree bark, leaves, and rocky terrain. A stream flows through the landscape, surrounded by foliage and boulders. More trees can be seen in the distance, leading into the shadowy depths of the forest. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Death and the Woodman in a Coastal Landscape with Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene combining natural and architectural elements. In the foreground, there are gnarled trees and a bird perched on a branch. A man kneels before a cloaked skeletal figure holding a scythe. In the background, there are distant trees and what appears to be the ruins of a classical structure with arches and columns. The horizon line is implied, falling in line with the tops of the ruins' arches. The artwork uses meticulous cross-hatching and line work in a sepia tone, giving the scene depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Two Saints
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from two blocks: black line block and yellow-brown tone block
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures in a pastoral setting. The figures are positioned in a serene, natural environment, with flowing lines and dynamic postures. They appear to interact closely, suggesting a sense of connection or familial bond. The background consists of stylized trees with foliage in a simplified, almost abstract form. The drawing emphasizes contrast and shadow for depth and movement. The style is reminiscent of classical etchings, focusing on line work and form.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Two Saints
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in black from line block only [proof]
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to and within border): 31 x 21.7 cm (12 3/16 x 8 9/16 in.)
support: 32.3 x 22.5 cm (12 11/16 x 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three central figures in a wooded, outdoor setting. The main focus is on two women and a child. The woman on the left is kneeling and has her arms around the child, who is standing between them. She has her hair styled in a bun and is wearing a long dress. The second woman is seated and looking towards the child while gently supporting their back. She has wavy hair wrapped in a cloth and wears a similar long garment. The child appears to be standing upright between them and is unclothed. To the right, in the background, there are two bearded men looking towards the group. The background features stylized trees and clouds, forming a serene natural setting that blends with the expressive style of the figures.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saints Peter and Paul [recto]
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from three blocks: dark green line block, gray-green and light gray-brown tone blocks
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within border): 28.5 x 46 cm (11 1/4 x 18 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of classical figures in a mythological setting. Various figures are depicted in different poses. In the center, there is a muscular figure wielding a sword. Surrounding this character are other figures. Above them, a winged figure soars through the air. The background includes towering architectural structures reminiscent of ancient temples or palaces. The artwork uses line and shading to convey depth and emotion.
